extracted.name: Leek Dip
extracted.description: This delicious leek dip made with finely chopped leeks, cream cheese, creamy salad dressing, and bacon bits makes a crowd-pleasing party dip!
instruction_lines: Mix chopped leeks, cream cheese, creamy salad dressing, vinegar, sugar, bacon bits, salt, and pepper together in a medium bowl. Refrigerate until well chilled, about 2 to 3 hours.
